# scc_service_domain_group (Data Source)

Look up an existing ServiceDomainGroup object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `organization` (String) Maps to the -Organization parameter.
- `site_addresses` (String) Maps to the -SiteAddresses parameter.
- `site_group_id` (String) Maps to the -SiteGroupId parameter.
